shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a red shirt sits in the plant-side window seat and poses a riddle, a man in a green shirt sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in an orange shirt sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and the plant-end seat and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: The man in a green shirt replies that he can find the answer. The man in a red shirt asks whether saying what one means is the same as meaning what one says.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a red shirt asks what day of the month it is. The man in a green shirt answers with the date.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the rectangular table.
